INSURANCE.TITLE: Quoting
INSURANCE.SUBTITLE: Connect the brokerage's AGGER account and link the Quoting Agent to your inboxes.

FORM.INTRO: Enter the brokerage's AGGER login. The password is stored securely and used only to keep the quoting session alive.
FORM.REQUIRED: Fill in user and password to connect.
FORM.SECURITY_NOTE: The password is never shown again nor sent to the AI agent.

CONNECTION.ENCRYPTION_UNAVAILABLE: This installation does not have the credential vault configured yet. The AGGER password cannot be stored until the {installationName} team enables encryption.

ERRORS.LOAD: Could not load the connection status.
ERRORS.GENERIC: Could not complete the action. Please try again.

ALERTS.RESCANNED: Fetching products and insurers from AGGER. It takes about half a minute and the screen refreshes on its own.

FAILURES.CREDENTIAL_REJECTED: AGGER rejected this login. Check the brokerage's user and password on the portal and connect again — the password may have changed or access may have been revoked.
FAILURES.SESSION_LOST: The AGGER session dropped and we are opening a new one. Your password is correct and does not need to change.
FAILURES.PORTAL_UNAVAILABLE: AGGER did not respond. The portal is unavailable, not your access; we will retry on our own.
FAILURES.PORTAL_TIMEOUT: AGGER took too long to respond. It is not a problem with your access; we will retry on our own.
FAILURES.INTEGRATION_OUTDATED: AGGER changed something our integration does not support yet. The {installationName} team has been notified — there is nothing for you to do.
FAILURES.REQUEST_INVALID: The request we sent to AGGER was invalid. It is our problem and has been logged.
FAILURES.NOT_SUPPORTED: This operation is not supported by the integration yet.
FAILURES.MISCONFIGURED: The integration is missing a required setting. The {installationName} team needs to fix it.
FAILURES.UNKNOWN: The connection is not healthy and the reason was not recorded — it was probably checked by an earlier version. Click Reconnect so the reason can be identified.

LAYERS.SUBTITLE: Each layer has its own proof. What nobody checked shows as not verified.
LAYERS.RUNTIME_DETAIL: Verified now, together with the session.
LAYERS.PLATFORM_AUTH: The account opens a session on AGGER

CAPABILITIES.SUBTITLE_NO_SCAN: Each product shows how many insurers respond for it.

AGENT.TITLE: Quoting Agent
AGENT.DESCRIPTION: A specialized {installationName} agent, already trained in insurance, that talks to the customer, collects what is missing, quotes with the insurers available on your AGGER account and sends the proposal. You customize only the brokerage's identity, tone and knowledge.

PILLARS.COLLECT: Identifies the line and collects only the data needed
PILLARS.QUOTE: Quotes with the insurers on your AGGER account and returns the prices
PILLARS.EXPLAIN: Answers coverage questions by checking the policy terms, never from memory
PILLARS.HANDOFF: Hands over to your team when the customer decides to close

AGENT.LOCKED_NOTE: The quoting journey, the AGGER forms and the safety rules are maintained by {installationName}. You define the identity, the hours and the behavior — and add what is specific to your brokerage.

FORM.TITLE: How your agent introduces itself
FORM.SUBTITLE: Four answers. Everything else comes ready.
FORM.NAME_HINT: This is how it introduces itself to the customer.
FORM.BROKER_HINT: The brokerage it represents in the conversation.
FORM.HOURS_HINT: When your team takes over. Outside these hours, the agent says they will reply on the next business day.
FORM.BEHAVIOR_HINT: When the agent explains coverage. In both cases it never answers from memory.
FORM.BEHAVIOR_CONSULTIVO_HINT: Explains what the customer will get before quoting.

EXISTING.TITLE: Your Quoting Agent already exists
EXISTING.NOTE: One per account. To change the name or the behavior, edit the agent.

ERRORS.NOME_INVALIDO: Check the agent name and the brokerage name.
ERRORS.HORARIO_INVALIDO: Check the business hours: write only the days and times, without variable markers.
